mapper.select: select * from system_app_versions where platform = #{platform} and is_published = true order by version_code desc limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into system_app_versions(platform, version_code, version_name, min_compatible_code, download_url, release_notes, update_strategy, is_published, publish_time) values (#{platform}, #{versionCode}, #{versionName}, #{minCompatibleCode}, #{downloadUrl}, #{releaseNotes}, #{updateStrategy}, #{isPublished}, #{publishTime})
